title: Researchers: Female Family Ties Important to Social Networks
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: A recent study suggests that female family ties were central to social networks in ancient Celtic society before the Roman invasion.
sentences.zh: 最近的一项研究表明,在罗马入侵之前,女性家庭联系是古代凯尔特社会社会网络的核心。

sentences.en: Genetic evidence from a late Iron Age cemetery in Britain shows that women were closely related.
sentences.zh: 英国一个已故铁时代墓地的遗传证据表明,妇女关系密切。

sentences.en: At the same time, unrelated men were more likely to come into the community from other places, likely after marriage.
sentences.zh: 同时,不相干的男子更有可能从其他地方进入社区,很可能是在结婚之后。

sentences.en: For the study, researchers examined ancient DNA from 57 burial places in Dorset in southwestern England.
sentences.zh: 研究人员为这项研究检查了英格兰西南部Dorset57个墓地的古代DNA。

sentences.en: People used the cemetery from around 2100 years ago to around 1800 years ago.
sentences.zh: 从大约2100年前到大约1800年前,人们使用墓地。

sentences.en: The results showed that two-thirds of the individuals descended from a single maternal lineage.
sentences.zh: 结果显示,三分之二的人来自单一的母系。

sentences.en: Lara Cassidy of Trinity College Dublin was one of the study’s co-writers.
sentences.zh: 都柏林三一学院的Lara Cassidy是该研究的共同撰稿人。

sentences.en: Cassidy suggested to the Associated Press (AP) that the results were surprising, or in her words, “jaw-dropping.” She said that such a finding had “never been observed before in European prehistory.”
sentences.zh: 卡西迪向美联社(AP)建议,结果令人吃惊,或者用她的话来说 : “ 偷看 ” 。 她说,“欧洲史前从未出现过这样的结论。 ”

sentences.en: The study appeared recently in the scientific publication Nature.
sentences.zh: 这项研究最近出现在科学出版物《自然》中。

sentences.en: The research suggests that women stayed in the same circles throughout life.
sentences.zh: 研究表明,妇女一生生活在同一个圈子里。

sentences.en: They kept social networks and likely inherited or managed land and property.
sentences.zh: 他们保持社会网络,并可能继承或管理土地和财产。

sentences.en: Cassidy told the AP that the findings suggest, “it’s your husband who is coming in as a relative stranger, dependent on a wife’s family for land and livelihood.”
sentences.zh: Cassidy告诉AP说,调查结果表明, " 你的丈夫是作为相对陌生人进来的,依靠妻子的家庭获得土地和生计。

sentences.en: Such a way of living is called matrilocality.
sentences.zh: 这种生活方式被称为母系地。

sentences.en: The researchers said it is historically rare.
sentences.zh: 研究人员说这是历史上罕见的。

sentences.en: Guido Gnecchi-Ruscone is with the Max Planck Institute in Germany.
sentences.zh: Guido Gnecchi-Ruscone是德国的Max Planck研究所的成员。

sentences.en: Gnecchi-Ruscone was not part of the study.
sentences.zh: Gnecchi-Ruscone不是研究的一部分。

sentences.en: He said researchers studying burial places in Britain and Europe have only discovered the opposite behavior.
sentences.zh: 他说,研究英国和欧洲埋葬地点的研究人员只发现了相反的行为。

sentences.en: He said in those communities, women left their homes and families to join their husband’s family group.
sentences.zh: 他说,在这些社区中,妇女离家出走,与丈夫的家庭团圆。

sentences.en: He said such a way of living, known as patrilocality, has been observed in other ancient time periods.
sentences.zh: 他说,这种生活方式被称为父系地,在其他古代时期也曾出现过。

sentences.en: These include the Neolithic period which started more than 10,000 years ago to the early Medieval period more than 1000 years in the past.
sentences.zh: 其中包括10 000多年前开始的Neolithic时期,到过去1000多年前的中世纪早期。

sentences.en: Cassidy said in studies of pre-industrial societies from around 220 years ago to the present, researchers found that men join their wives’ extended family households only eight percent of the time.
sentences.zh: Cassidy在大约220年前到现在对工业前社会的研究中说,研究人员发现男子只有8%的时间与妻子的大家庭家庭团聚。

sentences.en: But researchers already knew there was something special about the role of women in Iron Age Britain.
sentences.zh: 但是研究者已经知道 在英国铁时代 女性的角色有些特别之处

sentences.en: A group of tribes with closely related languages and art that is often described as Celtic lived in England before the Roman invasion about 2000 years ago.
sentences.zh: 一群有着密切关联的语言和艺术的部落 通常被称为凯尔特人 大约在2000年前罗马入侵之前就住在英国

sentences.en: Valuable objects have been found buried with Celtic women.
sentences.zh: 与凯尔特族妇女一起埋葬了宝贵的物品。

sentences.en: Roman writers, including Julius Caesar, wrote with disrespect about their relative independence and fighting abilities.
sentences.zh: 包括凯撒在内的罗马作家不尊重他们的相对独立和战斗能力。

sentences.en: The network of strong female family connections that the researchers found does not necessarily mean that women also held official positions of political power.
sentences.zh: 研究人员发现的强大的女性家庭关系网络并不一定意味着妇女还担任政治权力的官方职位。

sentences.en: Study co-writer Miles Russell of Bournemouth University in England researches ancient societies.
sentences.zh: 英国伯恩茅斯大学的麦尔斯·罗素 研究古代社会

sentences.en: He said the findings do suggest that women had some control of land and property and strong social support.
sentences.zh: 他说,调查结果确实表明,妇女对土地和财产拥有某种控制,并得到强有力的社会支持。

sentences.en: Such a situation made Britain’s Celtic society more “egalitarian” than the Roman world, Russell said.
sentences.zh: Russell说,这种情况使英国凯尔特社会比罗马世界更“加利特人”。

sentences.en: I’m John Russell. Christina Larson reported on this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: Christina Larson为美联社报导此事。

sentences.en: John Russell adapted it for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: John Russell改编了它 用于VOA学习英语。
